Before you turn on automatic detection
BroBehave will use Android\'s VPN feature on this phone to notice visits to adult websites. Here is exactly what that means.
What is checked

Only the names of websites your phone looks up (for example “example.com”), compared on this phone against a list of adult sites. Not pages, not messages, not what you type. Nothing is blocked or changed, and your traffic is not sent through any BroBehave server.
What is shared
Only that a day was flagged. A flagged day lowers your rank for 7 days, and friends see your rank if you allow it. You get the Verified ✓ badge while detection stays on.
What is never shared or stored
Which sites, how many times, or at what time. Site names are thrown away the moment they are checked, even on this phone.
Good to know
A flagged day cannot be removed. Android shows a key icon while this is on, and a notification with a Turn off button. Only one VPN can run at a time, so this stops if you start another VPN app.
I understand and want BroBehave to check website names on this phone
